name: merge-strength-e2e-root-tolerant-planned-fixture
body: `merge_strength_refuses_a_component_without_an_implemented_by_claim`'s planned-only case relies on `plan_verify_at`'s language-root-tolerant realization treating a `rust.`-rooted planned node as realized by the scanned `go.` sibling, so narrowing that tolerance requires reshaping the fixture. The real-claim case also does not distinguish whether merge strength's scanned universe came from the database or the export, because the real FQN resolves in both; upgrade if the universe's source itself needs pinning.
